name: Keltner Channels
description: This keyword returns the Keltner Channel value. Since there are three different Keltner channels, this keyword gives you an option to select the channel you would like to fetch. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Keltner Channel value. Since there are three different Keltner channels, this keyword gives you an option to select the channel you would like to fetch. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632222410.png)

The above condition is checking if the LTP of Nifty Bank is between the Previous day(-1) upper and middle Keltner Channels.
